nodes.label: If smoke appears, pull off the road, switch off the engine, move away and call nine one one; do not try to fight the vehicle fire yourself.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning smoke means stop, evacuate and call; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: If a vehicle enters water without immediately sinking, try to escape through a window because water pressure may prevent the doors opening.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning early window escape avoids door-pressure problem; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Fuel-burning vehicle exhaust contains carbon monoxide, which can be fatal.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning vehicle exhaust can contain deadly gas; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Carbon-monoxide poisoning can cause headache, dizziness, weakness, stomach upset, vomiting, chest pain or confusion and may resemble influenza.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning carbon-monoxide symptoms can resemble illness; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: People sleeping in a running vehicle or leaving it running in a garage can die before noticing carbon-monoxide symptoms.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning sleep can hide warning symptoms; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Everyone in a vehicle can be harmed by carbon monoxide, with particular risk for infants, older people and people with heart, lung or blood disorders.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning carbon monoxide threatens every occupant; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The handbook recommends an annual mechanic’s inspection of the exhaust and prohibits running the vehicle in a garage attached to a home.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning inspect exhaust and avoid attached-garage running; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: If power lines fall on the vehicle, occupants should remain inside until help arrives unless an immediate fire danger requires leaving.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning stay in vehicle under fallen lines unless fire forces escape; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: When fire requires escape from an electrified vehicle, jump clear without touching the vehicle and ground simultaneously.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning do not bridge vehicle and ground; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: After jumping clear, land with both feet together and hop or shuffle fifty feet away with arms kept near the body.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning move away with feet together; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Switch off the engine, avoid smoking near fuel pumps and stay with the pump while refueling.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning refueling means engine off and attendance; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A thumping noise can warn of a tire blowout; ease off the accelerator, hold the wheel firmly, pull off safely and avoid sudden braking.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning blowout response uses steady control; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Respond to the loss of a wheel or tire using the same controlled response as for a blowout.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning lost wheel follows blowout response; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: If steering control fails, ease off the accelerator, use hazard lamps, brake very gently and let the vehicle slow to a stop.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning steering failure needs gradual slowing; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Do not switch off the ignition on a vehicle with power steering or a steering lock during steering failure because steering assistance or steering ability may be lost.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning keep ignition on to preserve steering ability; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: If the pedal suddenly goes to the floor, pump it to try to restore pressure; if that fails, use the parking brake and a lower gear to slow.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning failed brake pressure has listed backup actions; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: For sudden headlamp failure, try hazard, parking or turn-signal lamps and leave the road; dimming lamps call for a service location or pulling off to seek help.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning lost headlights require leaving road safely; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: If a stuck accelerator cannot be freed, select neutral and brake gently to reduce speed.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning stuck pedal, neutral and gentle braking; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: If the forward view is blocked, lower a side window to see, activate hazard lamps and pull off the roadway.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning blocked view requires safe exit from traffic; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Aggressive driving means operating in a way that endangers or is likely to endanger people or property.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning aggression is dangerous operation; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Speeding, disregarding red lights or stop signs, tailgating, shoulder passing and cutting off another vehicle are examples of potentially aggressive driving.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning aggressive acts include dangerous traffic maneuvers; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Sudden braking at a tailgater, hostile gestures, shouting and repeated horn or headlight use can be aggressive acts.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning hostile signals can escalate driving aggression; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Do not retaliate or engage an angry driver, and avoid eye contact.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning do not engage road aggression; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Keep doors locked and windows closed near an aggressive driver, and leave enough space ahead to pull away from behind another vehicle.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning keep protective space and closed vehicle; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Do not underestimate another driver’s capacity for aggression.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning treat aggressive potential seriously; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: High-capacity roads are designed for heavy traffic and often have multiple lanes and traffic-management features, while low-capacity roads generally serve lighter flows with fewer features and lower speeds.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning road design and flow distinguish capacity; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: On a high-capacity road, move as far right or into another safe location as possible, stay buckled inside, activate hazard lamps, call nine one one and wait for responders.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning high-capacity breakdown means wait buckled inside; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: On a lower-capacity road, first move to a safe location clear of passing traffic, using the right shoulder if possible.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning move breakdown away from traffic; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: If leaving is necessary and safe on a lower-capacity road, exit away from approaching traffic and move to a protected place such as behind a barrier or onto a sidewalk.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning safe exit goes away from passing traffic; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: If a safe exit is unavailable, remain buckled inside, turn on hazard lamps and call nine one one for help.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning unsafe exit means remain secured inside; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: On an Illinois toll road, move far onto the right shoulder if possible, remain belted inside, use hazard lamps and call star nine nine nine or nine one one while waiting for assistance.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning toll-road breakdown has designated assistance numbers; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.
